title: How to Add a Light Leak Effect to a Photo on iPhone
description: Add film light leaks to iPhone photos: edge, window and burn leaks in soft red, orange or golden, plus toy cameras that leak by design. Settings inside.
h1: How to add a light leak effect to a photo on iPhone
card_title: Add light leaks to a photo
card_summary: Edge, window and burn leaks in red, orange or gold, and the toy cameras that leak on their own.
quick_answer: A light leak is the warm glow from light that got onto the film by accident. In Halatto, open the photo, tap Light Leak, choose a preset (Soft red, Orange, Golden), pick the type (Edge for a glow from one side, Window for a soft patch, Burn for a strong blown-out flare), then set Color, Amount and Position. Or pick a toy camera look, such as Tunnel 35 or Dream 120, that already leaks.
intro: Light leaks came from cheap or old cameras with gaps in the body, from opening the back too early, or from the end of a roll. Today they are the quickest way to make a photo feel warm and nostalgic.
The trick is to keep them subtle and put them where light could actually get in: the edge of the frame.

steps.heading: Step by step: light leak in Halatto

items.name: Pick a film look
items.text: A leak looks best on film color, so start with a look such as Snap Gold or Titan 38.

items.name: Open Light Leak
items.text: Choose Soft red, Orange or Golden.

items.name: Place it
items.text: Set Color, keep Amount low, and move Position so the leak comes from an edge, away from faces.

items.name: Save
items.text: Tap the checkmark, then save or share.

tips.heading: Tips
items: One leak per photo. Several at once look like stickers.
Warm leaks (orange, golden) suit sunsets; soft red suits night and neon.
In a set, vary the leak's position a little so each frame looks individual.

faq.question: Are light leaks a mistake?
faq.answer: Originally yes, now mostly a style. They signal film and imperfection, which is why they are popular on social media.

faq.question: Can I remove a light leak later?
faq.answer: Yes. Reopen the edit in Halatto and set Light Leak back to Original.

faq.question: Do light leaks work on black and white photos?
faq.answer: Yes; on black and white they show as a bright, washed-out glow.
